title: PayPal Diwali gifts distribution to students

photo.alt: PayPal Diwali gifts distribution to students

summary: To cheer up meritorious students for Diwali, a distribution of gifts given by PayPal India was done.
description: To cheer up meritorious students for Diwali, a distribution of gifts given by PayPal India was done. A total of 113 students received hampers containing goodies for the children along with ration items to support their families. Earlier, on 12th October, six students received the gift hampers from the hands of PayPal staff. Asha Janardhan, Ashish Shetty, and Dr. Ajay Sati joined the Principal, President, and a teacher of Shri Sai Vidyalaya, Mankhurd to distribute gift hampers donated by PayPal, the global fintech company with its office in BKC.
